test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

‘P = Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’.

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

If A + B % C = D # F, how is F related to A?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 +
 =
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Son
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: A + B % C = D # F

It means: A is the Daughter of B, B is the Brother of C, C is the Son of D, D is the Wife of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3abb9110f3f499188088cb7ea9e9184231690aee0ab983d9c1e5033ca1ad023.png] 

Here, F is the 'Father’s father' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
